acceptance: Local native pairing requires explicit authorization, renews and revokes credentials and denies unmatched peers.

positive.fixture: offer started by the user, code never on the wire, PBKDF2 and HMAC proofs both ways, rotation, revoke from either side, restart keeps a hashed registry

negative.fixture: wrong codes burn the offer, expired offer, other origin, rate limit, concurrent finish pairs once, reused refresh secret revokes the client

regression.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/browser-tests exec playwright test specs/extension-bridge.spec.ts specs/bridge.spec.ts

versions.primitive: no primitive change; wasm ABI 4, protocol vsf-ext-v1, pairing and session endpoints v1

security_and_source_permissions: Tokens are bound to the extension origin; the registry is hashed in a 0600 file.
known_limitations: A local process that can read the code can pair; a spoofer can burn an offer and the user re-issues it
